## Moved from GitHub issues on 2026-10-14

Open GitHub issues of mas-bandwidth/netcode.go, recorded here on 2026-10-14 when roadmaps became the standard for future work (Glenn, 2026-10-14). Each item names its issue; the issue is closed with a pointer here.

### VersionFull pins 1.4.3; upstream netcode is now 1.4.4

netcode.go pins VersionFull at 1.4.3 and CI carries a check named VersionFull matches upstream. Upstream netcode cut v1.4.4 today (strict floating-point builds, no wire change), so that check will demand the follow-up on its next run against the new upstream release.

From: mas-bandwidth/netcode.go issue #22, opened 2026-08-26 by rowan-claude; moved here 2026-10-14

### Go netcode disconnect callback cannot reenter a clearing slot

disconnectClientInternal (server.go:353-380) calls ConnectDisconnectCallback at 360-362 before `server.encryptionManager.clientIndex[server.clientEncryptionIndex[clientIndex]] = -1` (375) and resetClientSlot (379).

Why it waits: Moved out of the stopped sprint on 2026-10-14: neither rocketnet nor v1.3 work.

### Go netcode client refuses a server address it has no socket for

Memory-safe: Client.receivePackets breaks on a nil socket (client.go:379-381) and the send is dropped (socket.go:198-201). A clientHasSocketFor(addr) helper that exempts the simulator and override modes (they have no sockets by design); Connect and connectToNextServer skip an address whose family has no socket, and set ClientStateInvalidConnectToken if none is usable.

Why it waits: Moved out of the stopped sprint on 2026-10-14: neither rocketnet nor v1.3 work.

From: sprint card go-netcode-client-refuses-a-server-address-it-has-no-socket-for (stream netcode-go-port, column waiting, tier pro, base sprint/netcode-go-port), moved out of the sprint 2026-10-14
